## Which file do I need?

| Download | For | How to install |
|---|---|---|
| `dora-plugin-{{VERSION}}-claude.zip` | Claude Desktop / claude.ai | Plugins → Upload local plugin |
| `dora-assessment-{{VERSION}}-chatgpt.zip` | ChatGPT | A workspace admin uploads it under Admin → Plugins |
| `dora-assessment-{{VERSION}}-mistral-web.zip` | Mistral Vibe web app | Unzip, then Context → Skills → Upload skill folder |
| `dora-assessment-{{VERSION}}-mistral-cli.zip` | Mistral Vibe CLI | Unzip, then run `vibe/install.ps1` (Windows) or `vibe/install.sh` |

Claude Code users install from the marketplace instead and need none of these files.

The **Source code** downloads that GitHub adds to every release are not installable. Use one
of the files above.

You also need your own Knowledge Base key or sign-in, which E&P provides separately.
